label: one-pass-second-largest
notes: Tracks largest and second largest distinctly in one pass.

label: sort-and-scan-distinct
notes: Sorts then scans backward for second distinct value.

label: duplicate-bug
notes: Fails when the largest value appears more than once.

label: sample-driven-returns
notes: Mostly hardcodes tiny cases and falls back to the first element.

label: mask-and-check
notes: Classic left-shift mask plus bitwise AND.

label: right-shift-and-one
notes: Uses right shift instead of an explicit left-shift mask.

label: and-index-directly
notes: Incorrectly ANDs with index instead of a shifted mask.

label: parity-shortcut
notes: Pretends bit 0 means odd-even and guesses 0 otherwise.

label: floyd-cycle-detection
notes: Builds optional cycle and uses fast/slow pointers.

label: visited-set-detection
notes: Uses HashSet of node references instead of fast/slow pointers.

label: compare-values-not-nodes
notes: Incorrectly compares node values instead of node references.

label: pos-means-cycle-shortcut
notes: Uses the construction detail directly instead of actually detecting a cycle.

label: value-stack-right-to-left
notes: Uses a decreasing stack of values scanning from right to left.

label: index-stack-right-to-left
notes: Uses a decreasing stack of indices instead of raw values.

label: previous-greater-confusion
notes: Scans from left to right and accidentally computes a previous-greater style answer.

label: sample-shape-only
notes: Recognizes the sample and otherwise prints -1 everywhere.

label: deque-of-indices
notes: Canonical deque-based sliding window maximum.

label: priority-queue-window-max
notes: Valid O(n log n) max-heap solution instead of a deque.

label: no-window-expiry
notes: Forgets to remove expired indices from the front.

label: window-sample-only
notes: Returns the sample output when the sample input shape appears.

label: memoized-recursion
notes: Uses top-down recursion with memoization.

label: bottom-up-tabulation
notes: Correct iterative DP that avoids recursion altogether.

label: wrong-base-cases
notes: Incorrectly treats n=2 as one way.

label: small-n-shortcut
notes: Handles only a few small values directly.

label: answer-space-binary-search
notes: Binary-searches speed with a monotonic feasibility helper.

label: left-closed-right-open-style
notes: Uses a low<high variant of answer-space binary search.

label: wrong-hour-division
notes: Uses floor division instead of ceil hours per pile.

label: sample-speed-shortcut
notes: Recognizes the sample and otherwise falls back to the maximum pile.
